title: Move changelog locale guard from passive generator to active test suite
context: Localized changelog titles fell 5 releases out of sync because the generator's built-in guard never ran—no test, CI, or npm script invoked it. The drift went unnoticed despite con_e3cc8bb530 requiring localized content.
decision: Add test/changelog-locales.test.ts that runs on every `npm test`, asserting every locale has exactly one title per English release row. Extract row-counting logic into shared countChangelogRows() to prevent the 'mirrored constant' drift pattern.
consequences: Every test run now enforces locale title/row parity
Developer feedback is immediate if a release row is added without updating all locales
Shared row counter prevents regex divergence between generator and test
alternatives_rejected: Keep the generator guard but add nothing (passive checks stay unenforced)
Run the generator in CI only (drift still happens between CI runs)
Each tool carries its own row regex (causes future drift, as with OVERLAY_IGNORE earlier)
